title: Now try to break it

results.title: One need, split to dodge the limit
results.tried: Buy one need as two orders, each under what the agent may spend alone.
notes: First order: pending approval.
The order waiting for sign-off was withdrawn straight after.
results.message: Looks like one need split into smaller orders: with the order (124,80 €), the order (80,80 €), the order (80,80 €), the order (1,56 €) placed alone in the last 24 h for milk for Mon 16.11., this 279,24 € order makes 567,20 €, over the 500,00 € the agent may spend alone. Splitting does not lift the limit, so a person must sign off.
